description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Ekko''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] in the target direction, then empowers his next basic attack within 3 seconds to have a 0.25-second cast time, gain [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] 300 '''bonus''' range, cause him to [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|blink]] within 125 range of the target, and deal '''bonus''' magic damage.
description.text: Active: Ekko dashes in the target direction, then empowers his next basic attack within 3 seconds to have a 0.25-second cast time, gain  300 bonus range, cause him to blink within 125 range of the target, and deal bonus magic damage.

description2.raw: ''Phase Dive [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Ekko's''' basic attack timer. '''Ekko''' can cast any of his abilities during the dash.''
description2.text: Phase Dive resets Ekko's basic attack timer. Ekko can cast any of his abilities during the dash.

leveling.raw:
'''Bonus Magic Damage:'''
50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 (+ 40% AP)

notes.raw: * The [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dash]] distance can be extended to up-to 550 units when targeting across terrain. It will only extend for the distance needed to cross the wall. * While [[File:Grounded icon.png|20px|link=Ground|An icon representing the keyword Ground]] [[:Ground|grounded]] or [[File:Root icon.png|20px|link=Root|An icon representing the keyword Root]] [[:Root|rooted]], '''Ekko''' loses the [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] '''bonus''' attack range from ''Phase Dive''. * ''Phase Dive's'' attack can [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|miss]] and be [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]] and [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]], consuming the basic attack without dealing any damage. * ''Phase Dive's'' attack [[File:Breaking stealth icon.png|20px|link=Stealth#Breaking_stealth|An icon representing the keyword Break stealth]] [[:Stealth#Breaking_stealth|breaks stealth]] at the start of its cast time. ** This is relevant for external sources of [[File:Guerrilla Warfare.png|20px|link=Stealth|An icon representing the keyword Stealth]] [[:Stealth|stealth]] such as [[File:Senna OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Senna|An icon representing Senna]] [[Senna|Senna's]] [[File:Senna Curse of the Black Mist.png|20xpx|border|link=Senna#Curse of the Black Mist|An icon for Senna's ability Curse of the Black Mist]] [[Senna#Curse of the Black Mist|Curse of the Black Mist]]. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away during the empowered attack's cast time, it is cancelled but not consumed.
notes.text:
The dash distance can be extended to up-to 550 units when targeting across terrain. It will only extend for the distance needed to cross the wall.
While grounded or rooted, Ekko loses the  bonus attack range from Phase Dive.
Phase Dive's attack can miss and be blocked and dodged, consuming the basic attack without dealing any damage.
Phase Dive's attack breaks stealth at the start of its cast time.
* This is relevant for external sources of stealth such as Senna's Curse of the Black Mist.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away during the empowered attack's cast time, it is cancelled but not consumed.
